intent: Quantify the introversion likelihood associated with being a cat person.

requirements.question: Are all required composition entities, rings, and states represented?
Report the introversion likelihood associated with being a cat person as a partial-ring gauge value.

units.claim: All required composition entities appear in single composition.
accept: all required labels or sectors are visible
each entity is correctly bound to its arc, center label, or annotation
reject: fabricated label for an unnamed remainder
entity assigned to the wrong panel or ring

units.claim: Being a cat person is associated with an 11% introversion likelihood, shown as the filled portion of a partial ring.
reject: the complement is the reported value

optional_valid: Labeling the gauge as introversion likelihood or introversion rate.
Showing the 11% value as a printed number alongside the partial ring.
unsupported_to_avoid: Treating the 11% as a share of all people rather than a gauge value.
Adding or comparing other sectors that are not in the data table.
Describing colors, layout, or file format as analytical content.
review_notes: The single row is a gauge role with relative_value 0.11, so the required semantic unit is the gauge value, not a share-of-whole composition.
No complement unit is required because the intent asks to quantify the stated likelihood, not to derive the unspecified remainder.
approval_basis: Human sampling review completed; remaining items approved as a batch.
